speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic. I understand you are experiencing weakness and fatigue; to help me identify the cause, could you please describe when these symptoms started and if you have noticed any changes in your weight or appetite?

speaker: Patient
text: 33-year-old woman. The patient reports feeling extremely fatigued and weak, especially towards the end of the day, to the point of difficulty in self-care. She mentions experiencing these symptoms currently. The patient has been traveling, hiking, and camping recently and notes having had multiple illnesses in the recent past.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for that history. Given your recent travel, hiking, and camping, have you noticed any specific patterns with your weakness, such as it worsening after eating certain foods or in the heat, and do you experience any muscle cramps or tingling?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Weakness and fatigue. I also have Mild diplopia.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Myasthenia Gravis

The combination of worsening fatigue, difficulty with self-care, and mild diplopia (double vision) is highly suggestive of a neuromuscular junction disorder. Given the recent stressors of travel and illness, this could be a crisis, but we must confirm the diagnosis.
